tools.name: search_deals
tools.description: Search current flight deals from Luxembourg (default) or nearby airports. Returns return-trip prices in EUR with dates, the usual route price, a booking link and when the price was last checked.

tools.name: get_deal
tools.description: Get the current price of one deal by id. found=false means it is gone or expired.

tools.name: list_destinations
tools.description: List destinations that have current deals, with the cheapest price and departure airports.
